svg.title: Unified Capture Visual Design Suite (Family Cookbook Era 3)
svg.desc: Complete Era 3 visual design specification covering all 6 What's for Supper Capture screens with one consistent vertical grammar (Header + X -> Source block -> Inline Duplicate advisory below source -> Personal Rating and Notes -> Single Hearth CTA), editable Rating and Notes on privacy-scrubbed .txt imports, calm top-subtitle AI disclosure on Describe, upload status only while in flight on PDF, stripe-free Home async feedback, Paired Duplicate Review, Era 3 RecipeImportIssueSheet, French expansion, and High Contrast AAA proofs.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 · Capture & Import Suite
Save & Return Home · Standard AA & AAA
One coherent vertical grammar across all 6 screens: Header + × → Source → Duplicate advisory below source → Your Rating & Notes → Single Hearth CTA.
1 · All 6 Capture Screens — Identical Vertical Rhythm, Zero Layout Jump & Consistent Metadata

g.text: From any recipe website or blog
Name & family notes — we’ll draft it
• Open warm-cream header (no legacy divider bar).
• Calm photo CTA (no extra instructional clutter).
• Home trigger: "Photo, link, PDF, or idea".
Tap a photo to mark or clear the main dish cover.
• Hub collapses once staged; "+ Add photo" in grid.
• 800ms upload overlay kept for slow transfers; 202
returns straight to Home (no 10s wait screen).
We’ll fetch ingredients and steps once you save.
Already in your library: Creamy Garlic Pasta
• Duplicate banner sits directly below Link URL —
input never shifts downward under your thumb.
• Same slot as Describe & Shared .txt below.
• 202 intake returns straight to Home (no overlay).
We’ll draft ingredients and steps with AI so you can
Already in your library: Our family spaghetti
Slow-simmered beef & pork meat sauce with
crushed tomatoes, oregano, bay leaf, and
grated carrots for the kids. Serves 6.
HONEST TOP SUBTITLE · CLEAN CTA FOOTER
• AI disclosure lives calmly under the title (no
legal-style box stacked over the Save button).
• Duplicate banner sits right below Recipe name.
PDF recipe · up to 10 pages · 20 MiB
One recipe per PDF · pages stay viewable later.
Add pinch of clove; double pastry
• Drops idle upload-lock footnote above Save.
• While saving, button shows "Preparing your PDF…"
+ inline role="status" wait note below CTA.
Already in your library: Classic Shepherd’s Pie
• Shared .txt scrubs sender’s notes, rating & PII.
• Importer adds their own Rating & Notes here
(exact same slot as Photo, Link, and PDF!).
• Duplicate banner sits right below preview card.

svg.text: 2 · Save-and-Return-Home Async Feedback (Calm Cards, No Left Stripes), Duplicate Review & Issue Sheet

g.text: A · AMBIENT IN-FLIGHT STATUS ON HOME (RIGHT AFTER SAVE → HOME)
Carry on — we’ll let you know when it’s in your library.
C · PERSISTENT FAILURE BANNER (SSE recipe_failed · SINGLE DISMISS)
Recipe couldn’t be saved — Grandma’s Tourtière.
Your original file is still safe. Retry now or manage later in Settings.
CALM ERA 3 CARDS (NO HARSH LEFT STRIPES)
• Drops border-l-4 stripes in favour of rounded borders + tinted icon medallions (matching Board 02).
• Ambient Home ribbon confirms intake + gives a 1-tap "+ Add another" shortcut with zero waiting screen.
Discarded copies stay in Recycle Bin.
Add a note to request automatic repair.
All targets >= 48px · Full EN + FR copy
HOW YOU REACH PAIRED DUPLICATE REVIEW (3 DIRECT PATHS)
1. Tap LibraryToast (“Possible duplicate — tap to review”) right when import finishes.
2. Recipes → Filters → Reported (or Needs review pill) → tap card → inline “Compare & resolve”.
3. Tap the Reported badge or “Review issue” inside RecipeDetailSheet’s ••• menu.

svg.text: 3 · French Bilingual Parity (FR Expansion) & High Contrast AAA Proof

g.text: French Bilingual Proof (Ajouter une recette · Note · Doublon possible)
High Contrast AAA (:root[data-contrast="high"]) · Crisp Borders & Focus
below source → Rating & Notes → Hearth CTA.
• Drop idle footer disclaimers & left stripes.
• Flag new recipe with Duplicate + linked
• Reach via Toast, Needs review, or Detail.
